title: Classification of blow-ups for the Alt--Phillips problem in three dimensions
summary: We prove a flatness theorem for classical stable homogeneous solutions of the $γ$-Alt--Phillips free boundary problem in three dimensions in the range $0<γ\le 2/3$, where $γ$ is the exponent in the energy density $|\nabla u|^2+u^γ$. In particular, this implies full regularity of the free boundary for minimizers of the corresponding Alt--Phillips energy in dimension $3$.
